note_tweet.text:
卧槽！全新的 𝕏 原创激励将于9月上线

几个改变如下：

1. 即日起，暂停 Revenue Sharing 旧创作者激励的申请。

2. 已是创作者身份的人数据将更新至9月7号，之后要重新申请审核是否满足条件。

3. 在这之前还有3次奖励可以领取，分别是8/14、8/28和9/11。

4. 新的创作者奖励计划叫「Original Content Rewards，OCR」，顾名思义接下来的奖励将只发给「原创内容」，通过搬运、回复、转发、和AI自动化等方式实现的路子基本走不通了。

5. 如果你现在不在“旧计划”的人，可以直接去 Creator Studio 申请加入新计划，需要满足的条件如下：

• Premium/Premium+ 订阅用户
• 至少有 500 个蓝V用户粉丝
• 过去 90 天内，你的帖子在蓝V用户的首页的展示量总和至少有 50 万（评论的展示量不算）
• 年满 18 岁
• 居住在计划支持的国家/地区
• 账号没有违规历史
• 持续发布原创内容

申请之后，3 个工作日会出结果，被拒绝可以再申诉一次，又失败了就得等 90 天后才能再申请。

6. 如果你的账号过去被暂停收益，此次依然无法申请加入 OCR 项目。

7. 在加入 OCR 后你依然需要持续满足以下条件，才能保持资格并获得奖励：

• 持续订阅 X Premium、Premium+ 或 Premium Business
• 持续发布上述定义的原创且真实的内容
• 避免恶意或欺诈活动
• 不要篡改该计划、支付系统或推荐算法
• 不得使用自动化工具、机器人或任何工具或软件来人为生成点赞、关注、观看、评论或分享
• 不得在参与该计划的过程中发表虚假陈述、制作辱骂性内容或从事非法活动
• 不得诱导互动：反复指示用户与帖子互动，例如要求点赞、回复、收藏、关注或转发

看到不少朋友的 GiffGaff 卡陆陆续续被关了，我的目前还幸存没动静，但是已经把主要的注册服务做了一波迁移。

提前整理，万一被关停服务后卡里余额索回的方案：

具体操作步骤（建议立刻做）
1.  登录账户：用电脑访问 https://t.co/tnbYlAtyQp（用用户名登录，别用号码），检查dashboard。余额可能显示为“Not available”，但账户还在。

2.  确认/添加支付卡：去 Profile → Payment details，确保有有效的英国借记卡/信用卡（退款必需）。如果已移除，重新添加。

3.  联系客服申请退款：
- 通过官方支持表单提交（推荐）：登录后找 “Ask an agent” 或直接用相关链接（如Top-up balances相关表单），说明情况：“My service has been disconnected, I request a refund of the remaining unused credit balance of £XX. Card details are updated.”

- 常用入口：https://t.co/rhMNySAnpP 或 https://t.co/H74w7KogRw 相关表单。

- 客服通常24小时内回复（查看 Messages / support/questions）。

- 如果是近期激活（14天内冷却期），取消规则更宽松。

4.  （可选）保号：如果号码还重要，且能操作，尽快发短信 “PAC” 到 65075（或网页申请），拿到PAC后转到其他英国卡。转网后余额不会自动转移，再单独申请退款。

5.  升级投诉（如果客服拒绝）：通过官方投诉渠道（help中心有“how to make a complaint”），强调是未使用的预付credit。

卧槽！全新的 𝕏 原创激励将于9月上线

几个改变如下：

1. 即日起，暂停 Revenue Sharing 旧创作者激励的申请。

2. 已是创作者身份的人数据将更新至9月7号，之后要重新申请审核是否满足条件。

3. 在这之前还有3次奖励可以领取，分别是8/14、8/28和9/11。

4. 新的创作者奖励计划叫「Original Content Rewards，OCR」，顾名思义接下来的奖励将只发给「原创内容」，通过搬运、回复、转发、和AI自动化等方式实现的路子基本走不通了。

5. 如果你现在不在“旧计划”的人，可以直接去 Creator Studio 申请加入新计划，需要满足的条件如下：

• Premium/Premium+ 订阅用户
• 至少有 500 个蓝V用户粉丝
• 过去 90 天内，你的帖子在蓝V用户的首页的展示量总和至少有 50 万（评论的展示量不算）
• 年满 18 岁
• 居住在计划支持的国家/地区
• 账号没有违规历史
• 持续发布原创内容

申请之后，3 个工作日会出结果，被拒绝可以再申诉一次，又失败了就得等 90 天后才能再申请。

6. 如果你的账号过去被暂停收益，此次依然无法申请加入 OCR 项目。

7. 在加入 OCR 后你依然需要持续满足以下条件，才能保持资格并获得奖励：

• 持续订阅 X Premium、Premium+ 或 Premium Business
• 持续发布上述定义的原创且真实的内容
• 避免恶意或欺诈活动
• 不要篡改该计划、支付系统或推荐算法
• 不得使用自动化工具、机器人或任何工具或软件来人为生成点赞、关注、观看、评论或分享
• 不得在参与该计划的过程中发表虚假陈述、制作辱骂性内容或从事非法活动
• 不得诱导互动：反复指示用户与帖子互动，例如要求点赞、回复、收藏、关注或转发

Serving the X community has been the privilege of a lifetime. X is, and will remain, the most important communication technology in history. But running this app is a 24/7 job and it's now time for me to take a breather.

The app is seeing unprecedented growth in new users & engagement. We continue to break records every month. We've climbed 70 spots in the App Store since this time last year.

And in the last 400 days, we rebuilt almost every aspect of X: the Timeline, the Android app, onboarding, notifications, chat and more.

We also launched nearly 30 new products while protecting the integrity of the town square: becoming the first app to show Country-of-Origin on profiles and mounting defenses against AI bots. There's certainly much more work to be done, but our foundation is stronger than ever.

None of this would have been possible without the incredible team here. The next leaders will take X to even greater heights with @benjitaylor on design, @singhai on core product engineering and @dinkin_flickaa on mobile engineering -- among many other great people.

Thank you to Elon and the X team for welcoming me into the company. See you on the Timeline.

Hello people of Sol! I've reset usage limits for all ChatGPT Work and Codex users. Together with that, a quick update on GPT-5.6 Sol usage limits.

Over the past few weeks, many of you have told us that Sol was using your Codex limits faster than expected. To be clear, we have not reduced usage on any subscription plans.

We’ve been digging into what was happening and have landed several improvements. As a result, we expect your usage to last around 18% longer during typical use of Sol. Some of you should already see significantly larger improvements from today. Tomorrow, we’ll also restore the five-hour limit that we temporarily paused while investigating.

Here’s what we found:
- GPT-5.6 Sol is much more willing to work for longer, make additional tool calls, and coordinate complex workflows across tools and subagents. That makes it better at solving hard problems, but some tasks were using far more than we intended.
- Sol also works harder at the same reasoning effort than previous models. High on Sol can use more tokens than High did on GPT-5.5.
- Programmatic tool calling, also referred to as code mode, gives Sol much more flexibility to run tool calls in parallel or continue working while waiting. But it also led to more responses per turn, more cached input tokens, and higher usage than expected.
- This was particularly noticeable when Sol was waiting for tool calls to finish or running many web searches. We’ve improved how we handle both cases and are continuing to make code mode more efficient.
- The impact was also very uneven. The median user actually found Sol quite token efficient, while some power users working on harder tasks saw their usage drain much faster. We were very focused on average and median usage before launch and missed some cases where the long tail could use significantly more usage.

Sol is a significant step forward in what Codex can do, but capability and efficiency do not always improve at the same pace, and some issues only become clear once people are using the model at real-world scale. We should have recognized this sooner and been more upfront about it.

You keep pushing the frontier and we’ll keep improving efficiency and sharing updates as we go.
